why: rc8: settings v2 for the owner's in-game test

args.notes:
WoWFA Forever 1.0.0-rc8 (test build, built by wowfa2 CI).

New settings window: a side menu with General, Quests, Quest tracker, Map and zones, Spellbook, Talents, Status, About. Spellbook and Talents each choose how the name (Persian only / Persian + English below / English) and the description (Persian replaces English / below / off) are shown, or follow the General default.

Includes rc7: armor / language lists, Quickness, Wisp Spirit, fresh miss list per version.

Tip: for Persian spell names and terms choose the preset 'fully Persian' in /wowfa.
